headline: OpenAI unveils GPT-5.6 with Ultrafast mode, revolutionizing AI processing speed.

items.title: The builder's guide to GPT-5.6
items.summary: OpenAI releases comprehensive guidance on utilizing GPT-5.6, highlighting its capabilities for building faster, more cost-efficient AI agents. Key features include smarter model selection and new Responses API capabilities, allowing for enhanced efficiency and performance in AI development.
items.why_it_matters: Understanding and leveraging these new capabilities can significantly enhance the efficiency and performance of AI-powered tools.

items.title: Previewing Ultrafast mode: GPT-5.6 Sol at up to 14X the speed
items.summary: OpenAI introduces Ultrafast, a new service tier for the GPT-5.6 Sol model, which runs up to 14 times faster than previous versions. Leveraging Cerebras technology, this service can deliver up to 750 output tokens per second, significantly enhancing the speed of AI processing and reducing latency.
items.why_it_matters: This advancement in speed can drastically reduce processing times, making AI applications more responsive and efficient.

items.title: Introducing Gemini 3.7 Flash
items.summary: Google DeepMind releases Gemini 3.7 Flash, a new model that aims to improve the efficiency and capabilities of AI systems.

items.title: Custom reward functions for multi-turn reinforcement learning with Amazon Nova Forge
items.summary: Amazon Nova Forge introduces custom reward functions for multi-turn reinforcement learning, allowing developers to design composite multi-turn reward systems and safely execute model-generated code.

items.title: Building agentic workflows with SageMaker AI and Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: Amazon provides a guide on combining OpenAI-compatible endpoints on SageMaker AI with Bedrock AgentCore to build multi-agent workflows with token-level observability.

items.title: Diagnostic Foundation for Evaluating LLMs' Research Integrity as Co-Scientists
items.summary: A new benchmark, IntegrityBench, is introduced to evaluate the research integrity of language models when deployed as co-scientists, focusing on misconduct classification and ethical action recognition.

items.title: Position: We Need Practical AI Alignment Methods to Mirror Human Reasoning
items.summary: This paper argues for AI systems that are accurately cognitively-aligned with human reasoning, particularly in high-stakes decision-making scenarios.

Custom reward functions for multi-turn reinforcement learning with Amazon Nova Forge
all_items.summary: In multi-turn reinforcement learning, your custom reward function decides what the model actually learns. This post shows how to design a composite multi-turn reward for Amazon Nova Forge, execute model-generated code safely inside it, and instrument each component to catch the pitfalls that quietly collapse a reward.

all_items.title: Building agentic workflows with SageMaker AI and Bedrock AgentCore
all_items.summary: Learn how to combine OpenAI-compatible endpoints on Amazon SageMaker AI with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime to build a multi-agent workflow where each specialized agent uses the model best suited to its job. This post also shows how to get token-level observability from SageMaker endpoints that Strands Agents does not instrument by default.

all_items.title: Monitor on-premises and multi-cloud AI agents with AgentCore Observability
all_items.summary: Set up Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Observability for AI agents running outside AWS: on-premises, on GCP, on Azure, or on developer machines. This walkthrough uses the AWS Distro for OpenTelemetry (ADOT) and IAM credentials to route session traces, span metrics, and token usage to the same AgentCore Observability dashboard.

all_items.title: Automate legacy web applications with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Browser Tool
all_items.summary: Learn how to automate legacy web applications that need human-like interaction using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Browser Tool and Strands Agents. This walkthrough covers a reference architecture for an AI-powered digital worker that drives legacy interfaces through secure, isolated browser sessions while preserving human oversight and full audit trails.

all_items.title: Accelerating M&A due diligence with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
all_items.summary: Learn how to build a multi-agent M&A due diligence system on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. This post walks through a reference architecture that combines agent orchestration, knowledge retrieval, and governance controls, then deploys a complete sample you can run in your own AWS account.
